svg.title: Ash-Shu'ara — Fourier Bloom
svg.desc: Fourier Bloom generated from all 1318 written words in surah 26.
svg.metadata: {"surah":26,"name":"Ash-Shu'ara","method":"Fourier Bloom","words":1318,"letters":5552,"selectedVerse":null,"mapping":"u=(length-globalMean)/globalSD; c_k=mean(u_j*exp(-2*pi*i*k*j/N)); K=min(12,floor((N-1)/2)); f=2*Re(sum(c_k*exp(i*k*theta))); B=2*sum(abs(c_k)); r=100*(1+.7*f/B); zero B gives circle; faint contours are partial sums with the full B","source":"https://api.quran.com/api/v4/quran/verses/uthmani","counting":"Unicode whitespace words; Unicode L letters except U+0640/U+06E5/U+06E6; no normalization"}
